events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: On this day in 1981, MTV launched in the United States, famously kicking off with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: 45 years since MTV changed the game. Remember watching the very first video? 'Video Killed The Radio Star' – quite the statement!

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994, featuring classics like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years of 'Definitely Maybe'! Oasis' debut album dropped today in '94, shaping a generation. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: Peace, love, and three days of music. On this day in '69, Woodstock became more than a festival – it was a cultural phenomenon.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations and move millions. What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, passing away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of Tupac Shakur today. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable, 30 years on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, a true trailblazer, on the anniversary of his passing. His guitar mastery is still unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years of 'Abbey Road'! The Beatles' masterpiece dropped today in '69. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment or lyric?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' on this day in 1975, a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally with its powerful message of peace.

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday on this day, born in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years of 'The White Album'! The Beatles' iconic double LP dropped today in '68. Which track from it is your go-to?
